response.text:
Here are the deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library books** to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt [party:pty_d2ymm5s3htd0], due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees increase the longer they're overdue, and once high enough your account can be blocked.
- **Decide on an objection (Widerspruch)** to a contribution assessment from Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3], due Wed 14 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Contributions must still be paid even if you object, since it has no suspensive effect.
- **Decide on an objection (Einspruch)** against an assessment from Finanzamt Musterstadt [party:pty_mcq97yavgqjy], due Wed 21 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a]. If not filed in time, the assessment becomes final.
- **Mobile contract cancellation window**: your FunkNetz Smart M contract with FunkNetz Mobil GmbH [party:pty_gjsv4q2d3ajw] can be cancelled by Wed 14 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026, ahead of the current term ending Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- **Energy contract – price increase**: your MusterStrom Flex contract with Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH [party:pty_fh8cf155ffm3] has a price rise taking effect Sun 1 Nov 2026; to cancel before that, it must arrive by Sat 31 Oct 2026 — to be safe, send by Mon 26 Oct 2026 (a safe internal target of Fri 30 Oct 2026 is also noted) [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].

Let me know if you'd like details or draft-letter links for any of these.
